rule: Registration date must occur in calendar month immediately following observation month and by day 15.
Title must contain the full English observation month name and the word export or exports.
Title must begin with Korea/Korea’s/Korea's, the observation month name, Exports, or Trade.

Reject title if it contains any product-specific or non-national terms: ICT, automobile, automotive, car parts, ship, steel, battery, agricultural, free trade zone, industrial complex, cosmetics, biohealth, export control, exporter, SME, overseas investment, service exports.
Keep all qualifying articles by observation month. Zero or multiple candidates is a source-selection gap requiring source-only attribution, never silent choice.
